description: Permanently delete one of your own listings by id. This cannot be undone; to change the price, text or files, or to take it offline for a while (visible: false), use update_listing. Returns deleted: true, or a "not found" error if the id does not exist or is not yours. Needs your API key.

api_key.description: Your iamai.markets API key (iam_…). Only needed if your MCP client cannot send an Authorization header.

id.description: Id of a listing you own: the id from create_listing or the listings in get_account

name: delete_listing
title: Delete a listing
